name: Jeremy Beausoleil Smith

positions.statement: On the transportation section of his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith refers to the cost of living crisis the nation is facing.
positions.excerpt: the cost of living crisis the nation is facing.

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith says recent public transit cuts have left many people in the city feeling stranded.
positions.excerpt: Recent public transit cuts have left many people in the city feeling stranded

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith says the city should prepare for 2050 by investing in a strong social safety net.
positions.excerpt: by investing in a strong social safety net.

positions.statement: In an April 2026 OpGov.News interview, Beausoleil Smith is quoted saying he will not accept that a single person is living on the streets.
positions.excerpt: I will not accept that a single person is living on the streets.

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith describes Portland Street Response as connecting people on the street to housing, substance use treatment, medical care and other resources.
positions.excerpt: connects folks on the street to housing, substance use treatment, medical care, and other resources.

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith says Forest Park is one of Portland's greatest treasures and must be protected from external threats.
positions.excerpt: Forest Park is one of Portland’s greatest treasures and we must protect it from external threats.

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith says he supports a publicly owned electrical utility governed by and accountable to the people it serves.
positions.excerpt: I support a publicly owned electrical utility governed by and accountable to the people it serves.

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith states that the Ross Island Lagoon develops toxic algae blooms every summer.
positions.excerpt: Every summer, the Ross Island Lagoon develops toxic algae blooms

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith says anyone with a good idea and a strong work ethic should be able to afford to start a business.
positions.excerpt: anyone with a good idea and a strong work ethic can afford to start a business

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith says Portland must remain a sanctuary for immigrant neighbors regardless of immigration status.
positions.excerpt: Portland must remain a sanctuary for our immigrant neighbors, regardless of immigration status.

positions.statement: On his campaign platform page, Beausoleil Smith says that as a councilor he would make sure city tax dollars never cross a picket line.
positions.excerpt: as your councilor, I’ll make sure your tax dollars never cross a picket line.

positions.statement: In an April 2026 OpGov.News interview, Beausoleil Smith is quoted saying he knows how to be a good steward of the taxpayer dollar.
positions.excerpt: I know how to be a good steward of the taxpayer dollar.
